zh: 我还没收到你的邮件。
en: I haven't {received|got|gotten} your email yet.

zh: 请在周五前确认收到。
en: Please {acknowledge|confirm} receipt by Friday.

zh: 我退订了这些营销邮件。
en: I {unsubscribed} from these marketing emails.

zh: 邮件太长了，我只是快速浏览了一下。
en: The email was long, so I just {skimmed|scanned} it.

zh: 他在邮件里提到了预算。
en: He {mentioned} the budget in his email.

zh: 你能再发一次附件吗？
en: Could you {resend} the attachment?

zh: 我待会儿给你发短信。
en: I'll {text|message} you later.

zh: 我把它标成了未读。
en: I {marked} it as unread.

zh: 地址不对，邮件被退回了。
en: The email {bounced} because the address was wrong.

zh: 我在 Slack 上 @ 了你。
en: I {tagged|mentioned} you on Slack.

zh: 回复时请注明您的订单号。
en: Please {quote|include} your order number when you reply.

zh: 请把我抄送上。
en: Please {copy|cc} me in.

zh: 他还没回我消息。
en: He hasn't {replied|responded|got back|gotten back} to my message.

zh: 我撤回了那封邮件。
en: I {recalled} the email.

zh: 报告请见附件。
en: Please {find|see} the report attached.

zh: 我刚看到你的消息。
en: I just {saw|read} your message.

zh: 我发邮件催了他截止日期的事。
en: I {chased|reminded|nudged} him about the deadline.

zh: 请告诉我你的想法。
en: Please {let} me know what you think.

zh: 我昨天给客户写了一封很长的邮件。
en: I {wrote} a long email to the client yesterday.

zh: 请将此邮件视为正式通知。
en: Please {treat|take|consider} this email as formal notice.

zh: 我已经附上了报告。
en: I've {attached} the report.

zh: 我把他拉进了群聊。
en: I {added} him to the group chat.

zh: 我写信是想确认一下明天的会议。
en: I'm {writing} to confirm tomorrow's meeting.

zh: 我把这封邮件归档了。
en: I {archived} the email.

zh: 我已经把邮件转发给你了。
en: I've {forwarded} the email to you.

zh: 请签字后寄回。
en: Please {sign} it and send it back.

zh: 他起草了一封给客户的邮件。
en: He {drafted|wrote} an email to the client.

zh: 我接受了会议邀请。
en: I {accepted} the meeting invitation.

zh: 期待您的回复。
en: I {look} forward to hearing from you.

zh: 请勿回复此邮件。
en: Please do not {reply|respond} to this email.

zh: 请注意，周一办公室不开门。
en: Please {note} that the office is closed on Monday.

zh: 请注意，办公室周一不开门。
en: Please {bear|keep} in mind that the office is closed on Monday.

zh: 那封邮件别点全部回复。
en: Don't {reply-all|reply all} to that email.

zh: 有任何问题请随时联系我。
en: Feel free to {contact|email|call|ring|message} me if you have any questions.

zh: 他声称从来没收到过我的邮件。
en: He {claims|says|insists} he never got my email.

zh: 有家公司一直给我发垃圾邮件。
en: This company keeps {spamming} me.

zh: 如果有什么需要，尽管给我打电话，别犹豫。
en: Don't {hesitate} to call me if you need anything.

zh: 他完全无视了我的消息。
en: He completely {ignored} my message.

zh: 你可以设置一条规则，自动过滤垃圾邮件。
en: You can set up a rule to {filter} spam automatically.

zh: 详情请参阅附件。
en: Please {refer} to the attachment for details.
